verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a public REST or GraphQL API, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404, so there is no evidence of API coverage, let alone parity with the UI. A first-party remote MCP endpoint exists with read/write scopes, but it is undocumented, its tool surface is unknown, and it belongs to the separate MCP-server story rather than UI-parity API coverage. All other documentation describes UI, calendar-hashtag and add-on interactions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
